ITEM 1 | Cubed pieces, about 1.5–2 cm, off-white to pale cream with light golden-brown edges and seared surface, firm, slightly fibrous cut faces, dry-looking, piled in the center and across the upper-middle of the bowl | 150
ITEM 2 | Sliced avocado, bright green flesh with slightly darker green skin edges, smooth glossy sheen, soft and buttery, in thick wedges about 0.5–1 cm thick and 4–6 cm long, scattered around the right side and center of the bowl | 110
ITEM 3 | Mixed salad greens, dark green to bright green leaves, some small curled and flat leaves, matte with slight moisture, spread under and between other ingredients on the left and lower areas of the bowl | 30
ITEM 4 | Broccoli florets, dark green, small bite-sized clusters about 2–3 cm across, slightly textured surface, sitting near the top-left and upper-center edge of the bowl | 25
ITEM 5 | Shredded carrot, bright orange thin strips, matte and slightly moist, in a loose mound on a separate small plate at the far left edge of the image | 30
ITEM 6 | Flaked tuna-like mixture, pale beige to light brown, crumbly and moist, with small green flecks, mounded on a separate small plate at the left edge | 40
